snippet.title: MOO-A-DOODLE-DOO development gameplay
snippet.description:
Hide.
Transform.
Change your voice.
Trick your friends.
DON'T GET CAUGHT. 

In MOO-A-DOODLE-DOO, you can transform into all kinds of things and use voice-changing to confuse the Seeker.

🐮 Become something unexpected.
🎙️ Sound like something you're not.
🎭 Trick the Seeker.
😂 Cause chaos with your friends.

Who would you transform into?

🎮 Coming soon to Steam!
Steam URL : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5087240/MOOADOODLEDOO/


#MooADoodleDoo #PartyGame #Multiplayer #IndieGame #HideAndSeek #Steam
